metadata.question: Does the location at coordinates 34.770153, -118.423217 (with a 300-meter radius) show a solar farm, rather than a water pond based on Landsat imagery from April 14, 2020?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about distinguishing between a solar farm and water pond at a specific location using Landsat imagery from April 14, 2020. Strategy: 1. Use Landsat 8 surface reflectance data for the exact date 2. Focus on spectral characteristics that distinguish water from solar panels: - Water: Low NIR reflectance, high NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) - Solar farms: High NIR reflectance, low NDWI, characteristic spectral signature 3. Use NDWI = (Green - NIR)/(Green + NIR) to detect water 4. Also check NIR reflectance directly since solar panels typically have high reflectance in NIR I'll: - Get Landsat 8 imagery for April 14, 2020 - Create a 300m buffer around the point - Calculate NDWI and NIR reflectance - Use thresholds to classify as water vs solar farm - Validate pixel counts to ensure we have data The logic: - If NDWI > 0.1 and NIR < 0.15 → likely water pond (Answer B) - If NDWI < 0 and NIR > 0.2 → likely solar farm (Answer A) - Otherwise, inconclusive but leaning toward B (No) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.423217, 34.770153]); const region = point.buffer(300); // 300-meter radius const date = '2020-04-14'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Landsat 8 Surface Reflectance const landsat = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')); const collectionSize = landsat.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat images on ${date}: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get the image and apply scaling factors const image = landsat.first(); const scaled = image.select(['SR_B2', 'SR_B3', 'SR_B4', 'SR_B5', 'SR_B6', 'SR_B7']) .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); // Apply cloud mask using QA band const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3) // Cloud shadow .or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4)) // Snow .or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5)) // Cloud .eq(0); const masked = scaled.updateMask(cloudMask); // Calculate NDWI (Green - NIR) / (Green + NIR) const ndwi = masked.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B5']).rename('NDWI'); // Get NIR band for additional analysis const nir = masked.select('SR_B5').rename('NIR'); // Combine for analysis const analysisImg = ee.Image.cat([ndwi, nir]); // 3. Check valid pixels const pixelCount = analysisImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const validPixels = pixelCount.NDWI || 0; console.log(`Valid pixels after masking: ${validPixels}`); if (validPixels === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculate statistics const stats = analysisImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const meanNDWI = stats.NDWI; const meanNIR = stats.NIR; console.log(`Mean NDWI: ${meanNDWI?.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`Mean NIR reflectance: ${meanNIR?.toFixed(3)}`); // 5. Validation & Classification if (meanNDWI === null || meanNDWI === undefined || meanNIR === null || meanNIR === undefined || isNaN(meanNDWI) || isNaN(meanNIR)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Classification logic // Water: High NDWI (>0.1), low NIR reflectance (<0.15) // Solar farm: Low/negative NDWI, high NIR reflectance (>0.2) const isWater = meanNDWI > 0.1 && meanNIR < 0.15; const isSolarFarm = meanNDWI < 0 && meanNIR > 0.2; if (isSolarFarm) { console.log("Classification: Solar farm"); console.log("A"); } else if (isWater) { console.log("Classification: Water pond"); console.log("B"); } else { console.log("Classification: Neither clear water nor solar farm"); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
